scenario: Every Monday, read open vendor bills in QuickBooks, bucket them by days past due (current, 1-30, 31-60, 61-90, 90+), and post totals per bucket plus the top five overdue vendors to the #ap-team Slack channel.

When the controller asks for this week's collection targets, pull unpaid customer invoices from Xero, rank customers by overdue balance weighted by days late, and append the ranked list as rows in the 'Collections Queue' Google Sheet.
rule_hooks: overdue weighting formula, minimum balance threshold

scenario: After month close, compare actual expenses per department from QuickBooks against the approved budget tab in Google Sheets and email each department head their lines whose variance exceeds the allowed tolerance.
rule_hooks: variance tolerance percent and dollar floor

scenario: At the end of each expense cycle, read submitted expense reports in Expensify, count policy violations (missing receipts, over per-diem, weekend spend) per employee, and post a summary to the finance manager in Slack.
rule_hooks: expense policy limits, receipt requirement threshold

scenario: Each morning, read yesterday's ending balances from the bank-feed sheet for every operating account, total them by currency, and update the 'Cash Position' row in the treasury Google Sheet and post the total to #treasury.

When the month's bank statement CSV lands in Google Drive, match its transactions against QuickBooks deposits and payments, and send the controller an email listing unmatched items with their count and net amount.
rule_hooks: matching tolerance on amount and date

scenario: At month-end, aggregate approved but uninvoiced timesheet hours by client from Harvest, multiply by each client's contracted rate, and post the unbilled revenue estimate per client to the #billing Slack channel.

Before the quarterly filing deadline, total taxable sales and tax collected per state from Shopify orders and record one row per state in the 'Sales Tax Filing' Google Sheet, flagging states where collection crossed the nexus threshold.
rule_hooks: state nexus thresholds, taxable product categories

scenario: Each quarter, sum paid bills per vendor in Xero over the trailing twelve months and email procurement the vendors that account for more than a set share of total spend.
rule_hooks: concentration share threshold, vendor category map

scenario: Weekly, scan newly entered vendor bills in QuickBooks for possible duplicates (same vendor, amount, and close dates or matching invoice numbers) and post the suspected pairs with combined exposure to the AP lead in Slack.

Monthly, collect corporate card charges tagged as software from Ramp, group them by vendor and owning team, and update the 'SaaS Inventory' Google Sheet with this month's cost and month-over-month change.
rule_hooks: software merchant categories, team ownership list

scenario: On the first business day of the month, read Stripe subscription changes for the prior month, compute new, expansion, contraction, and churned MRR, and post the MRR bridge to the #exec-finance Slack channel.
rule_hooks: MRR classification rules, excluded plan types

scenario: At month close, pull the deferred revenue schedule from Google Sheets plus new annual contracts invoiced in QuickBooks, compute beginning balance, additions, recognized amount, and ending balance, and write the rollforward row into the close checklist sheet.

Before consolidation, read intercompany receivable and payable balances for each pair of entities from Xero, compute the out-of-balance amount per pair, and email the consolidation accountant the pairs exceeding tolerance.
After each payroll run, total gross pay, employer taxes, and benefits by department from Gusto and post a comparison to the previous run in the #fp-and-a Slack channel.
rule_hooks: department cost-center mapping, change alert percent

scenario: At month-end, compute days sales outstanding from QuickBooks AR balances and trailing revenue, add the value to the 'KPI Trends' Google Sheet, and notify the CFO by email if DSO rose above target.

Weekly, compare each customer's open AR in NetSuite against their approved credit limit in the credit master sheet and post customers above a utilization threshold to the #credit-control Slack channel.

Every Wednesday, read bills awaiting approval in Bill.com, count them and their total value per approver, and send each approver with items waiting longer than the SLA a reminder email that summarizes their queue.

In January, total calendar-year payments per vendor from QuickBooks, identify vendors marked 1099-eligible whose total meets the IRS reporting threshold, and write the list with totals and W-9 status into the '1099 Prep' Google Sheet.
rule_hooks: 1099 threshold, eligible vendor types, payment method exclusions

scenario: Every two weeks, sum costs charged to each capital project from QuickBooks classes against the project budgets in Google Sheets and post percent burned and remaining budget per project to the project's Asana task as a comment.

Monthly, read refunds issued in Stripe and refund-related tickets in Zendesk, total refund amounts by reason code, and email the revenue operations lead the top reasons and their share of gross revenue.

After month close, aggregate revenue and cost of goods sold by product line from the QuickBooks P&L-by-class report and update the 'Margin Dashboard' Google Sheet with each line's gross margin and change from the previous month.
rule_hooks: product line class mapping, margin target

scenario: Quarterly, sum airfare, lodging, and meals expenses from Expensify by department and compare against travel budget caps, then post the department totals and any over-cap departments to the #finance-ops channel.

At month-end, read bills in Xero coded to equipment and software accounts above the capitalization threshold, list them as candidate fixed-asset additions with amount and useful life class, and add rows to the 'Fixed Asset Register' Google Sheet.
rule_hooks: capitalization threshold, asset class useful lives

scenario: During the annual audit, read the auditors' prepared-by-client request list in Google Sheets and the related documents in the shared Drive folder, count items delivered, outstanding, and overdue per owner, and email the summary to the controller and audit lead.

Weekly, pull manual journal entries posted in NetSuite, flag those above the review threshold or posted by the same person who approved them, and record the flagged entries with totals in the 'JE Review' Google Sheet.

At month close, read the prepaid schedule in Google Sheets, compute this month's amortization per prepaid item and the remaining balances, and post the total amortization amount and ending prepaid balance to the #close Slack channel for the accountant to book.
On close day two, collect open purchase orders with goods received but no vendor invoice from the PO tracking sheet, total them by GL account, and email the accrual summary to the staff accountant.

Weekly, total open receivables and payables by currency from Xero, convert them at current rates from the FX sheet, and post net exposure per currency to the treasury manager in Slack, highlighting currencies above the hedging threshold.

Before each quarterly board meeting, compile revenue, burn, runway, and headcount from QuickBooks, Gusto, and the cash sheet into a summary Google Doc in the board-materials folder and notify the CFO.
Monthly, count and total customer payments received by method (ACH, card, check, wire) from QuickBooks and Stripe, and update the 'Payment Mix' Google Sheet with share and processing fees per method.
rule_hooks: processing fee rates, payment method mapping

scenario: At the end of each month, compare vendor bills with early-payment terms in Bill.com against their actual payment dates, total discounts captured versus missed, and email the AP manager the missed discounts by vendor.

After the month's deals close, read closed-won opportunities from Salesforce, apply each rep's commission plan from the comp sheet, and write per-rep commission totals into the payroll handoff Google Sheet and post the grand total to #payroll.
rule_hooks: commission plan rates and tiers, quota attainment

scenario: Weekly, read the reminder emails sent from the AR Gmail inbox and the corresponding payments in Xero, compute how many dunned invoices were paid within seven days by reminder stage, and post the results to #collections.

At month-end, read petty cash log entries from each office's Google Sheet, total disbursements and replenishments per office, compare to the counted cash balance submitted via form, and email the office managers whose counts differ.
rule_hooks: petty cash float amounts, discrepancy tolerance

scenario: Quarterly, sum expenses tagged to each restricted grant in QuickBooks against the award amounts and allowed cost categories in the grants sheet, and send the grants manager a report showing spend, remaining balance, and unallowable charges.
rule_hooks: grant award amounts, allowable cost categories

scenario: Monthly, read open and resolved disputes from Stripe, total amounts won, lost, and pending by reason, and create a summary row in the 'Chargebacks' Google Sheet while alerting #payments if the dispute rate exceeds the card network threshold.
rule_hooks: dispute rate threshold, reason code groups

scenario: On the 15th of each month, read customer contracts renewing in the next 90 days from HubSpot deals, total renewal ARR by expected close month and risk tier, and post the forecast to the #revenue-forecast Slack channel.

Weekly, count bank and card transactions in QuickBooks still sitting in uncategorized or ask-my-accountant accounts, total them by source account and age, and email the bookkeeper the list of the oldest and largest items.
rule_hooks: suspense account list, age and amount priority rules

scenario: Monthly, find vendor bills in QuickBooks from out-of-state vendors that charged no sales tax, compute use tax owed per state at the applicable rates, and log the totals in the 'Use Tax Accrual' Google Sheet for the tax accountant.
rule_hooks: state use tax rates, exempt purchase categories

scenario: On business day 3 of each month-end close, read the close task tracker (Asana/Sheets) and post to #finance-close a count of open, overdue and completed tasks per owner, highlighting any blocking reconciliations.
rule_hooks: close calendar due dates and task dependency map

scenario: Every Friday, pull customer payments in QuickBooks that are not applied to any invoice, total them by customer and age, and email the AR lead a list of receipts older than 15 days.
Monthly, compare vendors paid in the last 90 days in Xero against the W-9 tracker sheet and post a list of paid vendors lacking a W-9 on file, with total paid to each.
rule_hooks: W-9 requirement by vendor entity type

scenario: Each Monday, read corporate card transactions from the expense tool and Slack each cardholder's manager a count and total of transactions over $75 still missing receipts after 10 days.

Daily, compare new AP invoices against open purchase orders and goods receipts, then write a row per invoice with a price or quantity variance outside tolerance to the three-way-match exceptions sheet.

Ahead of each quarterly estimated tax deadline, pull year-to-date pretax income from the GL, apply the effective rate from the tax planning sheet, and email the controller the computed payment due versus payments already made.
rule_hooks: effective tax rate and safe-harbor rule

scenario: At quarter end, compute debt-to-EBITDA and current ratio from the trial balance and post a covenant compliance summary to the treasury channel, flagging any ratio within 10% of its limit.
Monthly, sum open purchase order balances by department and cost center and update the commitments tab of the budget workbook so remaining budget reflects committed spend.
rule_hooks: PO open-balance definition and cost center mapping

scenario: Each Wednesday, count submitted but unpaid expense reports by days since approval and Slack the AP manager the total owed plus reports past the 14-day reimbursement SLA.
Monthly, read helpdesk tickets tagged billing-dispute from Zendesk, group them by dispute reason and dollar value, and post a ranked summary to the revenue operations channel.
Weekly, list all entries posted to the suspense and clearing accounts that remain uncleared, age them, and email the GL accountant a summary with totals per account.
After each scheduled AP payment run, read the batch of bills paid in Bill.com and post to #ap a summary of total paid, count by payment method, and the five largest payments.
rule_hooks: payment batch definition and method categories

scenario: After close, build a one-row-per-account actual vs. budget statement for each cost center and email it to that cost center's budget owner listed in the ownership sheet.
Monthly, read project milestones marked complete in the project tool, match them to contract values in Salesforce, and post the revenue to recognize per contract to the rev-rec worksheet.
Weekly, pull credit memos issued in the accounting system, total them by reason code and approver, and flag any memo above the approval limit that lacks a recorded approver.
After each payroll run, compare gross pay, taxes and benefits to the prior period by department and Slack the payroll manager any department whose total moved more than 5%.
Weekly, read the vendor master change log for bank account updates and email internal audit a list of changes, noting whether a callback verification ticket exists for each.
At month end, pull on-hand quantities and unit costs from the inventory sheet, compute extended value by warehouse and category, and append a snapshot row to the inventory valuation log.
Quarterly, identify SKUs with no sales in 180+ days, compute the reserve per the aging tier schedule, and send the controller a proposed reserve summary.
At month end, bucket open AR by aging tier, apply reserve percentages from the allowance policy sheet, and post the required allowance and change from last month to the close channel.

Every Monday, read DocuSign envelopes for customer contracts that are sent but unsigned, sum their value from linked Salesforce opportunities, and post the pending booking total by sales rep to finance.
rule_hooks: envelope status and booking recognition rules

scenario: Monthly, compare actual filled roles from the HRIS export against the approved headcount plan sheet and update a variance row per department showing over/under-plan positions and cost impact.
rule_hooks: approved headcount plan and loaded cost rates

scenario: Each week, compare last week's forecasted receipts and disbursements to actual bank activity and write the variance by category to the 13-week cash forecast sheet, noting misses over $25k.
rule_hooks: forecast category mapping and variance threshold

scenario: At each VAT period end, total output and input VAT by rate from Xero invoices and bills for the UK entity and email the tax manager the net payable with a breakdown by rate.
rule_hooks: VAT rate codes and reclaimability rules

scenario: Monthly, compare invoiced unit prices in HubSpot deals against the price book and post a ranked list of reps and customers whose discounts exceeded the approved discount band.
rule_hooks: price book and discount approval bands

scenario: After preliminary close, compare each GL account balance to the prior month and prior-year month and write accounts exceeding both a dollar and percent threshold to the flux review sheet for explanation.
Monthly, total customer deposits and retainers held per customer from the deposits ledger, net of amounts applied, and post the outstanding liability balance with tie-out to the GL.
Monthly, scan paid bills for late fees and finance charges, total them by vendor and by root cause tagged in the AP notes, and email the AP manager the summary.
rule_hooks: vendor payment terms and late-fee identification

scenario: Quarterly, compare purchased seats per software contract against active users exported from each admin console and post the unused-seat cost by vendor ahead of renewals.
rule_hooks: contracted seat counts and per-seat price

scenario: At month end, allocate shared rent and IT costs across departments using headcount drivers from the HR sheet and append the resulting allocation journal amounts to the allocations workbook.
Monthly, read treasury holdings (T-bills, CDs, money market) from the investments sheet, bucket them by maturity month and yield, and email the CFO a maturity ladder with concentration by issuer.
rule_hooks: investment policy issuer and tenor limits

scenario: Each month, read the compliance calendar of state annual reports, franchise tax and payroll filings, and post a list of filings due in the next 45 days with owner and status.
Monthly, measure days from AP invoice receipt to approval to payment from the AP system timestamps and post median and 90th-percentile cycle times per approver to the AP channel.
rule_hooks: approval workflow stages and SLA targets

scenario: Quarterly, combine revenue by customer from QuickBooks with support ticket counts from Intercom and direct costs from the project tool to rank the 20 least profitable customers for account review.
Monthly, list travel and salary advances in the employee advances account that have not been settled by an expense report, aged by issue date, and email HR and payroll the employees past 60 days.

Monthly, read lease terms from the lease register, compute the period's interest and principal reduction under ASC 842, and update each lease's row in the lease schedule with the new liability balance.
rule_hooks: lease discount rates and payment schedules

scenario: Each Monday, read balances from every non-USD bank account sheet, convert at the treasury rate table, and post total trapped cash per country to the treasury Slack channel.
rule_hooks: FX rate source and repatriation restrictions

scenario: Monthly, total webinar and room-connector usage by department from the Zoom usage report and write the departmental chargeback amounts to the IT cost recovery sheet.
Daily, read outgoing wires initiated in the bank portal export, match each to an approval record, and email the treasurer a summary of wires sent with any lacking dual approval above the threshold.

Quarterly, sum sales by channel partner from Salesforce, apply tiered rebate rates from partner agreements, and post the rebate accrual per partner and change versus last quarter to the close channel.
